execution.reason_no_measurements_are_reported: The only available Gate 7 Gazebo runtime is for bcod_usv, not the Surveyor. Running it and labeling the result Surveyor conformance would compare different vehicles and produce invalid evidence.

confirmed_blocker.summary: The handoff premise that a validated Surveyor Gazebo SDF and orchestrator already exist is not true in the current workspace. The checked-in Gate 7 preparation path and generated runtime are hard-coded to the 1,000 kg bootstrap bcod_usv.

evidence.finding: Imports bcodUsvCoefficients and generates model/world/manifest files for bcod_usv.
Hard-codes the pre-rescale route and disturbance limits and labels inertia provenance as the bootstrap craft.
Gazebo command topics are hard-coded under /model/bcod_usv.
Contains mass 1000 kg, inertia [563.3333333333, 2003.3333333333, 2400] kg m^2, and thruster lateral positions +/-1.2 m.
Declares vehicle bcod_usv and bcod_usv command topics.

scope_disposition.why_repointing_is_insufficient: Changing only route, timeout, and disturbance inputs would leave Gazebo running the wrong mass, inertia, geometry, hydrodynamics, thruster placement, vehicle identity, and command topics.
scope_disposition.required_work_before_valid_rerun: Build and validate a Gazebo Surveyor SDF/vehicle port from the existing Surveyor single source of truth, update the existing process-lifecycle harness to select that already-validated model, and validate true-odometry episode capture before running held-out conformance.
scope_disposition.work_performed_here: Read-only audit plus this blocker artifact. No SDF, vehicle model, actuator integration, frozen contract, calibration, training, or VRX files were changed.
scope_disposition.halted_under_rule: Stopped because resolving the mismatch requires new vehicle/SDF modeling and validation, not an ordinary stale-parameter update.
scope_disposition.figure_disposition: If the Surveyor result appears in Fig 5, it is Node-only and carries the full Gate 3 failure label. No Surveyor Gazebo comparison is permitted until this port is explicitly resumed and completed.
